intro.text: Every sentence starts with a capital letter, and so do names and places. Let’s put Shift to work in real sentences.
intro.tip: Choose the Shift on the opposite side to the letter, every time.

steps.title: Names and places
steps.instructions: Every word starts with a capital letter.

steps.title: Sentences
steps.instructions: Capital at the start, full stop at the end.

steps.title: Hands-on challenge
text: My friend Priya lives in Leeds. On Monday we went to the Science Museum in London. Then we had lunch by the River Thames.
The Isle of Skye is in Scotland. Owen and Beth went there in June. They saw seals, puffins and a golden eagle.
steps.instructions: Hints fade out. Watch for the capitals.
